items.name: Three-Headed
items.text: Any ability that would sever a greater chimera's head (such as a critical hit with a Vorpal weapon) severs one head at random. Losing a head doesn't kill a chimera (as long as it has at least one head left), but it does prevent it from making Strikes with the lost head or using any abilities granted by the head.

items.name: Fire Breath
items.text: Doomcrier's magma worm head exhales a blast of flame in a 30-foot cone that deals 16d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 36 basic Reflex save save). It can't use Fire Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Multiple Reactions
items.text: A greater chimera gains 2 extra reactions each round that it can use only to make Reactive Strikes. It must use a different head for each reaction, and it can't use more than one on the same triggering action. If it loses one of its heads, it also loses one of these extra reactions.

items.name: Storm Blast
items.text: Doomcrier's thunderbird head blasts its foes with peals of thunder and crackling bolts of lightning. Each creature in a 30-foot emanation takes 8d6 electricity,8d6 sonic damage (DC 36 basic Reflex save save). Doomcrier can't use Lightning Blast for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Three-Headed Strike
items.text: The greater chimera makes a Strike with each of its heads, each at a –2 penalty and targeting a different creature. These Strikes count as only one attack for the greater chimera's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after it has made all three attacks.

items.name: Vision of Doom
items.text:
A creature hit by Doomcrier's black dog jaws Strike sees visions of their own doom. The creature must attempt a DC 36 Will save save. If Doomcrier critically hits, the creature also becomes Doomed 1 for as long as they are frightened by vision of doom.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and immune to vision of doom for 24 hours.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.
